title: Aureline M5 AI review resolution memory
description: Canonical per-domain descriptor for a resolution memory row. Names the object class, its review association, the resolution state (dismissed, published, suppressed), the finding freshness / outdated state, the reopen / rerun path, and the preserved-on-failure guarantee that keeps a local draft and its evidence when a publish fails — so a finding's durable history stays provable and no suppressed or outdated finding silently resurfaces as current. Downstream the resolution memory ledger, review detail, pending-review trays, and support / export packets point at this schema instead of restating a resolution by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
